label: Expense Report Policy Checker
description: Validates expense reports against company expense policy. Flags policy violations, missing receipts, unusual amounts, and suggests appropriate approvals or rejections.

claudeKnowledge.description: Expense management best practices, Swedish tax rules on deductibility, Skatteverket representation limits

guidedInputs.label: Company expense policy
guidedInputs.placeholder: Paste the relevant sections of your expense policy. Include: meal limits, accommodation limits, travel class rules, alcohol policy, receipt requirements, approval thresholds, and any category-specific rules.

guidedInputs.label: Expense report to review
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste the expense report. Include: employee name, date, description, amount, receipt status (Y/N), and any notes.

e.g.
Employee: Karl Lindqvist, Sales Director
Expense period: 10-14 February 2025

1. Client dinner (6 persons, Operakällaren) — 9 600 SEK — Receipt: Yes
2. Taxi to airport — 340 SEK — Receipt: No
3. Business class flight Stockholm-London — 18 500 SEK — Receipt: Yes
4. Hotel London (2 nights) — 6 200 GBP — Receipt: Yes
5. Team lunch (4 persons) — 1 450 SEK — Receipt: Yes

guidedInputs.label: Employee grade / level
guidedInputs.description: Some policies have grade-specific limits (e.g. business class only for VP+).

guidedInputs.label: Trip/expense purpose
guidedInputs.placeholder: Business purpose of the expense claim: e.g. client meetings in London with Barclays and HSBC, 2 days including presentation and contract negotiation.
